description: Ministry of Mass Media - Rule made under Section 45 (Chapter 190) of the Post Office Ordinance Money Orders Issued
reasoning: This gazette notification contains rules and regulations regarding the validity, refund procedures, and exceptional circumstances for Money Orders issued by the Post Office. It is made under statutory authority (Section 45 of the Post Office Ordinance) and establishes regulatory frameworks for financial transactions through postal services, making it a Legal/Regulatory gazette.
